meta.notes: 11 bechina edges extracted (reference===24, type==='bechina'). 6 raw connected components: (C) keter-cluster of 4 nodes, (D) shekhinah-cluster of 3 nodes, (E) klipot-cluster of 4 nodes, (A) kavod-emunah pair, (B) barukh-yadayim pair, (F) kodesh-mochin pair. Components A, B, and F all merged into Package 1 (C) based on shared nature: the verse in section ז of the Torah explicitly unites ברוך=ידים, כבוד ה'=אמונה, and ממקומו=כתר as a single structural triad; קדש=מחין shares the intellectual domain of כתר (mochin rush toward Ein Sof through Keter's partition). The result is 3 packages.

packages.label: כֶּתֶר, הַמֹּחִין וּבִרְכַּת הַיָּדַיִם
packages.label_en: Crown, Intellect, and the Hands of Blessing
packages.reason: All nodes share a single essential nature: they are aspects of the divine Crown (כתר) as the stabilizing, mediating boundary of the intellect, and of the mochin/hands through which divine blessing flows. The Torah in section ח explicitly defines כתר as 'the power within the intellect that settles and orders the mind so it does not break through its boundary' — two dataset nodes (המסדר והמישב את השכל and הכח שיש בהשכל...) are both bechina-equated with כתר and are therefore the same essential thing. ממקומו (from Ezekiel 3:12 'ברוך כבוד ה' ממקומו') is the bechina of כתר — it is the place of the Crown. The very same verse supplies the other two pairs: ברוך=ידים (the hands that distribute blessing downward) and כבוד ה'=אמונה (divine glory = faith). These three pairs are one structural triad in this Torah — the hands carry the blessing of faith to the place of the Crown. קדש=מחין ('קֹדֶשׁ זֶה בְּחִינַת מֹחִין') equates holiness with the intellect/brain — the mochin that race toward Ein Sof and strike Keter to create the heikhalot. All of these are facets of the same upper-intellect/Crown domain: the boundary, the blessing-channels, the faith that fills them, and the holiness that IS the intellect.
nodes: הכח שיש בהשכל של אדם לישב ולסדר את המח והדעת לבל יהרס לצאת חוץ מן הגבול

merge_notes.reason: CC-A (כבוד ה'=אמונה) merged into Package 1 because the Torah in section ז parses Ezekiel 3:12 as a three-part identity: 'ברוך זה בחינת ידים; כבוד ה' זה בחינת אמונה; ממקומו זה בחינת כתר'. Since ממקומו=כתר is the dominant node of Component C, and the verse treats all three pairs as a single structural statement, כבוד ה' and אמונה share the essential nature of the כתר-domain in this Torah. Emunah is also explicitly described as 'אמון מופלא' (hidden faithfulness) within Keter in section ז — faith IS the hidden quality of the Crown.

CC-B (ברוך=ידים) merged into Package 1 because the same Ezekiel verse ('ברוך זה בחינת ידים') places ברוך/ידים as the first element of the three-part triad culminating in כתר. The hands in this Torah are the vessels through which the sekhel-blessing flows downward (section ה: 'עיקר הברכה שנשפעין מהידים הם שכל'). The hands belong to the intellectual/crown domain — they are the expression of the mochin's blessing in the world. Shared nature: the hands = the downward-flowing intellect-blessing = the same domain as mochin/keter.

CC-F (קדש=מחין) merged into Package 1 because the Torah in section ו states 'קֹדֶשׁ זֶה בְּחִינַת מֹחִין' — holiness IS the intellect/brain. The mochin in this Torah are the central agents: they rush toward Ein Sof, strike Keter (the partition), and create the nine heikhalot. Mochin and holiness are the same essential reality — the intellect in its holy active state — and belong with the כתר cluster that the mochin crash against.

packages.label: שְׁכִינָה, לֵב וְשִׂמְחַת יִשְׂרָאֵל
packages.label_en: Shekhinah, Heart, and the Joy of Israel
packages.reason: All three nodes share a single essential nature: they are the same divine presence experienced from Israel's side. The Torah in section ב states 'גָּלוּת הַשְּׁכִינָה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת לֵב שֶׁהוּא שִׂמְחָתָן שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל' — a single clause that equates Shekhinah, heart, and Israel's joy. The Shekhinah IS the heart of the world; the heart IS where Israel's joy resides; and Israel's joy IS the Shekhinah's presence. These three are not cause and effect — they are three names for the same experiential-theological reality: the immanent divine presence that dwells within Israel as the joy of the heart. When sadness (the klipot, Package 3) overpowers the heart/Shekhinah, Israel goes into exile; when joy returns, the Shekhinah is liberated.

packages.label: קְלִפּוֹת, מוֹתָרוֹת, עַצְבוּת וְתָקְפָּא דְּדִינָא
packages.label_en: Klipot, Excess-Waste, Sadness, and the Power of Harsh Judgment
packages.reason: All four nodes share a single essential nature: they are aspects and names of the impure husks (קלipot) in their essential character as excess, sadness, and harsh judgment. The Torah in section ב states this in a single chain: 'הַקְּלִפּוֹת הֵם בְּחִינַת מוֹתָרוֹת, וְהֵם בְּחִינַת עַצְבוּת... וְהֵם תָּקְפָּא דְּדִינָא'. Klipot = excess-waste (the material that was not absorbed, the dregs); excess-waste = sadness (for wherever there is sorrow there is excess — Proverbs 14:23); sadness = the power of harsh judgment (the 'וַיִּתְעַצֵּב אֶל לִבּוֹ' of Genesis 6 being the prototype of divine grief/judgment). These four are not cause-and-effect — they are four simultaneous identities of the same dark reality. They form the evil counterpart to Package 2: where the Shekhinah is Israel's joy, the klipot are the force of sadness that exiles the Shekhinah from the heart.
